#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> arr[i];
    
    if (n % 2 == 1) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }
    
    map<int, int> cuts;
    int ec = 0, oc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if ((arr[i] & 1) == 0) ++ec;
        else ++oc;
        if (ec > 0 && oc > 0 && ec == oc) {
            if (i + 1 < n) {
                cuts[i] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i+1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (cuts.empty()) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    } else if (cuts.size() == 1) {
        int cost = cuts.begin()->second;
        if (cost <= b) {
            cout << 1;
        } else {
            cout << 0;
        }
        return 0;
    } else {
        vector<int> costs;
        for (auto& p : cuts) costs.push_back(p.second);
        sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
        int k = 0;
        for (int cost : costs) {
            if (cost <= b) {
                b -= cost;
                ++k;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        cout << k;
        return 0;
    }
}
